answer: Replica watchers fail a single-window raptor census. After locking 18.4 POA, the applicant has 31 minutes to reach garden plot GP-27 before civil dawn at 05:47, release banded falcon FL-09 from glove G-6, and hold a 90-second stoop over perch P-14 so camera CA-8 records a 12-frame wing-tag match within 1.2%. A second release from the same key cluster, a stoop after sunrise plus 8 minutes, or a reused band burns the 18.4 POA and bars roost keys for five epochs. Two aviary clerks rehash the camera file and band serial.
